title: Great and clean room!
description:
✨ About the Home
Welcome to your home-away-from-home in Mount Juliet, TN! I’m offering one fully furnished private bedroom in a quiet, safe neighborhood just minutes from Providence Marketplace and under 25 minutes to major Nashville hospitals. Perfect for travel nurses, corporate professionals, and relocations, each room includes all utilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, and access to shared home amenities — simply bring your suitcase and settle in.

Guest access
You can access and use the kitchen, laundry room, and backyard furniture as well as the living rooms, all we ask is to be organized and clean afterwards.

During your stay
You can call me or text me if you need something.

Other things to note
🐾 Meet Our Furry Friend

We share our home with a sweet and friendly cat who loves people — but she also totally understands personal space!
If you’re a cat lover, she’ll happily accept some gentle pets and might even keep you company during your stay. 🐱✨
If you prefer to keep your distance, no worries at all — she’ll quietly mind her own business and give you your space.

We also have a small puppy 🐶 our friendly Shihtzu

Either way, she adds a cozy, homey touch that many of our guests enjoy.
